probe.name: gene-value-plausible-what
probe.rationale: Keep the full 137-gene row set, statuses and all other growth values exactly as in the reference, but reduce the reported optimum for gene b2279 from the reference value 0.2116629497353111 to a plausible but incorrect number. The cobra/single-gene-deletion semantics of the E. coli core model put the b2279 deletion optimum well below wild-type growth (reference 0.2116629497353111, vs 0.8739215069684279 for the wild-type row of pfk_knockout_optima.csv), so 0.205 is still below wild-type but deviates from the reference value by far more than the accepted tolerance, simulating a solver or model-handling error that still produces a plausible looking number. probe.name: repr-reorder-rewrites
probe.rationale: Rewrite every `growth` value as a native full-precision decimal string of the same double (using Python's repr, which round-trips exactly), and reorder the data rows of every file. The reference stores values with 16-significant-digit repr (for example 0.7040369478590247 and -2.664219086176528e-15, exactly the CPython float repr style), so representing the identical double as Python repr, or promoting it to a wider dtype (e.g. numpy float64) and writing the full 17-digit shortest round-trip representation, is within the tolerance because the numeric value is unchanged (a compliant grader parses the string back to a double). Row order carries no scientific meaning (the public rule explicitly says \"any row order is acceptable\"), and the 18-nanosecond-level difference between 0.8583074080226888 and 0.8583074080226889 in the reference belongs to different rows, demonstrating that these near-identical doubles must be compared under the stated tolerance, not string equality. This variant keeps keys, statuses, infeasible-empty convention and row counts identical, so it must pass all scientific checks while exercising representation and ordering.
probe.script:
import csv

# applied to all four files; also shuffles the data rows to a deterministic non-reference order
files = ["single_gene_deletions.csv", "single_reaction_deletions.csv", "double_reaction_deletions.csv", "pfk_knockout_optima.csv"]

for path in files:
    with open(path, newline="", encoding="utf-8") as stream:
        reader = csv.reader(stream)
        rows = list(reader)
    header, data = rows[0], rows[1:]
    assert header == ["knockouts", "growth", "status"]

    for row in data:
        assert len(row) == 3
        if row[1] != "":
            value = float(row[1])
            assert value == value, row
            assert abs(value) < 1e30, row
            row[1] = repr(value)

    data.sort(key=lambda row: row[0])

    with open(path, "w", newline="", encoding="utf-8") as stream:
        writer = csv.writer(stream)
        writer.writerow(header)
        writer.writerows(data)
